{'content': '今年較早時，Twelve South 推出了全新的 Valet 配件，並將其形容為「無線充電座兼個人隨身物品收納盤」。', 'source': '今早，Twelve South launched a new Valet accessory, which it calls a "wireless charging stand and a catchall for your personal items."\n'}

{'content': '如今，Twelve South 擴展了 Valet 系列，新增一款體積更細小的選擇，配備 MagSafe 及 Qi2.2 無線充電，充電速度高達 25W。', 'source': 'Now, Twelve South is expanding its Valet lineup with a smaller version that includes MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at up to 25W.\n'}

{'content': '今年較早時發表的首代 Valet 尺寸為 7.5 吋，提供空間擺放手機、鎖匙、銀包、眼鏡等物品。然而，新版 Valet 的佔地面積大幅縮減至 4.25 吋。', 'source': 'The original Valet unveiled earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, providing space for your phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and more. However, the new Valet has a drastically smaller footprint of just 4.25 inches.\n'}

{'content': '以下是 Twelve South 對 Valet 極致尊貴設計的描述：', 'source': 'Here is how Twelve South describes the sophisticated design of the Valet:\n'}

{'content': 'Valet 首先是一件美觀的家居擺設，其次才是一部精密的無線充電器。它融合溫暖的材質與現代工藝，營造出更平靜、更具格調的造型，適合擺放於家中任何位置——由玄關的檯面，以至廚房，以至床頭几。柔軟的方形充電板與皮革托盤的建築線條互相呼應。同時，加重的鋅合金底座令一切穩固就位，井然有序。', 'source': 'Valet is first a beautiful piece of home decor, and second, a precision wireless charger. It pairs warm materials with modern craft for a calmer, more poised silhouette that feels at home anywhere — from the entryway table to the kitchen to the nightstand. The soft, square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray, while a weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything anchored in place.\n'}

{'content': '在功能方面，較細小的 Valet 具備充足電力為你的 iPhone 充電。它同時內建一個額外的 USB-C 插口，方便你為其他配件充電：', 'source': 'As for functionality, the smaller Valet has plenty of power for your iPhone, but it also includes an additional USB-C port for charging another accessory:\n'}

  • {'content': 'Qi2.2 無線充電高達 25W', 'source': 'Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W\n'}
  • {'content': '頂級 Nappa 皮革收納盤', 'source': 'Premium Nappa leather catchall tray\n'}
  • {'content': '四種可調校擺放方向', 'source': 'Four adjustable orientations\n'}
  • {'content': '可互換、可拆除的皮革邊框', 'source': 'Interchangeable, detachable leather trim\n'}
  • {'content': '加重鋅合金底座，配備隱藏式線材管理', 'source': 'Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management\n'}
  • {'content': '額外 USB-C 插口，提供高達 10W 有線充電', 'source': 'Additional USB-C port at up to 10W wired charging\n'}
  • {'content': '附送 45W 電源供應器及 1.5 米 USB-C 線', 'source': '45W power supply and 1.5m USB-C cable included\n'}

{'content': '4.25 吋版的 Twelve South Valet 現已接受訂購，售價 129.99 美元，提供三種顏色配搭。定價略高，但無論是放置手機充電，還是擺放眼鏡、銀包或鎖匙，都是賞心悅目的好選擇。', 'source': 'The 4.25-inch version of the Twelve South Valet is now available to order for $129.99 in three color combinations. It’s priced at a premium, but it’s a beautiful catchall for your phone while charging, and your glasses, wallet, or keys when not.\n'}

{'content': '請追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 及 Mastodon。', 'source': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.\n'}
